items.source: Provider for asynchronous stateless MCP complete methods. This provider creates completion specifications for methods annotated with McpComplete that are designed to work in a stateless manner using McpTransportContext and return reactive types.
items.translation: 为异步无状态 MCP 完整方法提供程序。 此提供者会创建适用于带有McpComplete注解的方法的完成规范，这些方法旨在通过McpTransportContext以无状态方式运行并返回响应式类型。

items.source: completeObjects - the objects containing methods annotated with McpComplete
items.translation: completeObjects - 包含用 McpComplete 注解的方法的对象

items.source: the list of async stateless completion specifications
items.translation: 异步无状态完成规范列表
